instruction: Set the default paragraph line spacing to 1.5 lines in LibreOffice Writer

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting default paragraph line spacing to 1.5 lines in LibreOffice Writer settings. The evaluator checks the registrymodifications.xcu configuration file for the LineSpacing property. The custom metric function check_default_line_spacing__e935e684876b9147d1bd4de0594cd5b3 parses the XML config file using a comprehensive search strategy: (1) searches all LineSpacing properties regardless of path location, and (2) checks specific paragraph-related configuration paths including DefaultParagraphStyle, DefaultStyle, and Styles sections. The postconfig ensures LibreOffice closes and settings are flushed to disk before verification.

llm_judge_reasons: Metric function implements comprehensive dual-strategy search for LineSpacing property: (1) searches ALL prop elements with oor:name='LineSpacing' regardless of parent path (lines 36-48), and (2) explicitly checks specific paragraph-related paths including DefaultParagraphStyle, DefaultStyle, and Styles sections (lines 50-68).
